subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 2 – Lesson 4: Book club – A poem
outcomes: I can name the features of a poem.
I can find rhyming words in the smartphone poem.
I can make adverbs with -ly, like quickly and easily.

tf.s: The lines in poems are usually short.
tf.why: Yes! Poems often have short lines.
Correct! They end with the same sound.

tf.s: A verse is a group of lines in a poem.
tf.why: Right! Poems are made of verses.

tf.s: The poem says the new phone's screen is much darker.
tf.why: The poem says the screen is much brighter.

tf.s: The map app helps you find your way more easily.
tf.why: Yes! You can get home safely.

tf.s: The adverb of easy is easyly.
tf.why: When an adjective ends in y, we change y to i: easily.

tf.s: The adverb of quiet is quietly.
In the poem, you can shop online with the smartphone.
tf.why: Yes! Shopping online is one use.

tf.s: Poems never have words that rhyme.
tf.why: Poems sometimes have words that rhyme.

boxes.q: The new phone's screen is much ___.
Check the facts more ___ on the screen.
A group of lines in a poem is a ___.
With the map app you can get home ___.

hunt.q: Group of lines in a poem
Words with the same end sound

mcq.q: What are the features of a poem?
mcq.why: Poems have short lines, rhyme and verses.

mcq.q: What does the poem say about the new phone?
o: It is thinner, lighter and brighter.
mcq.why: The latest smartphone is thinner, lighter and brighter.

mcq.q: In the poem, what is thinner, lighter and brighter?
mcq.why: The poem describes the latest smartphone.

mcq.q: Which is a use of the smartphone in the poem?
mcq.why: You can take a selfie with it.
Change y to i and add -ly.
We need an adverb to describe how he drives.

mcq.q: Complete: The baby is sleeping, so talk ___.
What can you do with the free map app in the poem?
o: Find your way more easily and get home safely.
mcq.why: The map app helps you find your way.

mcq.q: Why do "lighter" and "brighter" sound good together in the poem?
o: They rhyme, so the poem has rhythm.
mcq.why: Rhyming words give the poem its sound.

mcq.q: Which smartphone use keeps you safe, so it may be the most important?
o: finding your way with the map app
mcq.why: Finding your way helps you get home safely.
